source: Intel IA-32 instruction opcode maps; XWASM-maintained mapping layer
notes: Every legacy one-byte primary opcode slot and every 0F escape opcode slot is represented.
RESERVED means no XWASM encoding is currently attached; it does not by itself assert that Intel reserves the opcode in every mode.
Additional opcode maps such as 0F 38 and 0F 3A are represented by the schema and can be added without changing the file format.
The 0F 38 and 0F 3A maps are also materialized as complete 256-slot tables so future SSE/SSSE3/SSE4 expansion does not change the schema.
